## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] New behavior has a test
- [ ] If this touches sending, reactions or deletion: the confirmation and release-flag gates are unchanged, or the change is explained above
- [ ] The code matches the surrounding code and adds no dependency
- [ ] User-visible change: added a line under `[Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md
- [ ] README updated if tools or release flags changed
- [ ] No real messages, phone numbers or contact names in the diff
